linked_prs.title: feat: Add TerminalToolkit MCP server and examples
linked_prs.body:
Fixes  #2922 

This pull request introduces the capability to run the TerminalToolkit as a standalone MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. This enhancement allows AI agents and other applications to remotely access the powerful shell execution features of the toolkit in a standardized and scalable way, directly addressing the feature request.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because it requests packaging a toolkit (TerminalToolkit) as an MCP (Multi-Component Package), which directly concerns tool implementation and configuration within an LLM-based agent system—matching the "Tool-related issues" category in the taxonomy.
